message:
CARDS
C01 [person] Dinu - age: Dinu - 30, Colombo cash-transport driver.; details: Quiet, experienced, violent only when cornered.
C02 [person] Aruni - age: Aruni - 27, Mahawewa community nurse.; details: Strong, intelligent and emotionally controlled.
C03 [person] Nimal - age: Nimal - 34, Aruni's elder brother and Dinu's closest friend.
C04 [person] Mudalali - age: Mudalali - 52, businessman laundering illegal money through village development projects.
C05 [person] Suren - age: Suren - 38, Mudalali's brutal right-hand man.
C06 [person] Inspector Ruwan - age: Inspector Ruwan - 45, corrupt police officer protecting the money trail.
L01 [place, region] Colombo
L02 [place, region] Mahawewa village
L03 [place, set in L02] MAHAWEWA CANAL
L04 [place, vehicle in L01] CASH VAN
L05 [place, set in L01] COLOMBO GARAGE
L06 [place, spot in L03] canal gate
L07 [place, spot in L03] paddy field
P01 [thing] C-17 - appearance: Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.
P02 [thing] small medical bag - appearance: Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag.
P03 [thing] red thread
P04 [thing] metal box
P05 [thing] Rs. 300 million
P06 [thing] gun
P07 [thing] recording

DIRECTION RULES
D01 [palette, place L01] Colombo palette - Cold blue, green and sodium orange. Handheld camera, tight frames and crowded backgrounds.
D02 [palette, place L02] Village palette - Warm amber and earthy red. Locked-off frames, natural light and longer silences.
D03 [lens, all scenes] Love scenes - 50mm and 85mm lenses, shallow focus and minimal camera movement.
D04 [lens, all scenes] Action lenses - 24mm for geography, 35mm for movement and 50mm for emotional impact.
D05 [lighting, all scenes] Lighting - Vehicle headlights, sodium lamps, practical bulbs and lightning flashes.
D06 [editing, all scenes] Editing - Fast cuts only on impact. Let important punches and reactions stay on screen.
D07 [sound, all scenes] Sound - Rain, breathing, metal impacts and footsteps first. Music enters only for hero elevation moments.
D08 [slow_motion, all scenes] Slow motion - Use only twice: Nimal's key falling and Dinu removing the gun.
D09 [action, all scenes] The action is mass but not weightless. Every hit has a location, an object or a consequence.
D10 [action, all scenes] Dinu is not an invincible superhero; he wins because he knows vehicles, space and timing.
D11 [action, all scenes] Aruni is an active participant in the climax, and the final victory comes from the recording, the village and their courage - not from violence alone.
D12 [editing, scene 1] She calls Dinu. No answer. A distant bus horn mixes with the rain. Cut to black. TITLE: EKAMA SAKSHIYA.

CONTINUITY

SCENES TO BREAK DOWN
=== E01-S01 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
42: SCENE 01 - EXT. MAHAWEWA CANAL - DAWN - 1 MINUTE
43: Heavy rain. Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag. She notices
44: something caught near the canal gate: a body. It is Nimal. She does not scream. She kneels
45: and touches his hand. Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.
46: ARUNI - Dinu... oyata meka ahenne nadda?
47: She calls Dinu. No answer. A distant bus horn mixes with the rain. Cut to black. TITLE:
48: EKAMA SAKSHIYA.

=== E01-S02 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
49: SCENE 02 - INT. CASH VAN - COLOMBO - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES
50: Colombo streets shine under rain and sodium lights. Dinu drives a cash-transfer van. On the
51: dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop. Aruni's voice message
52: plays.
53: ARUNI - Nimal thama gedara awilla ne. Oya ada enawa kiyala kiwwa. Mata dan
54: baya hithenawa.
55: Mudalali calls. Route eka maru karapan. Old Port warehouse ekata yanna. Dinu looks at the
56: red thread around his wrist and turns toward the industrial area.

=== E01-S03 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
57: SCENE 03 - FLASHBACK - INT. COLOMBO GARAGE - 2 MINUTES
58: Six hours earlier. Nimal opens a metal box containing photographs, bank documents and the
59: C-17 key.
60: NIMAL - Mudalali ge salli. Rupiyal million 300. Village project walin gaththa salli.
61: DINU - Api meka gaththoth apiuth eyala wage wenawa.
62: NIMAL - Aruniwa aran yanna oyata oni neda? Eya salli nisa nemei, oyage baya nisa
63: oyawa atharinnawa.
64: Nimal places the key in Dinu's hand. Dinu looks at it as rain hits the garage roof.

scenes.title: The canal gate
scenes.summary: Aruni discovers Nimal's body and a marked key enclosed in his hand. Her attempt to reach Dinu goes unanswered.
scenes.purpose: Establish the death and the key as linked mysteries while leaving Dinu unreachable.

people.wants: Understand the discovery and reach Dinu.

blocks.intent: Move from an ordinary journey to recognition of the dead man.
blocks.delivery_hint: Allow recognition to register without an abrupt expressive flourish.

events.change: Her progress beside the fields is interrupted by a discovery.
The caught body is identified as her brother.

blocks.intent: Express distress through contact rather than an outcry.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the physical response small and deliberate.

events.change: Aruni lowers herself beside Nimal and makes contact with his hand.

blocks.intent: Give the small object evidentiary weight without explaining its use.
blocks.delivery_hint: Make the marking legible while preserving the stillness.

events.change: The marked key becomes visible within Nimal's closed hand.

blocks.speaker: C02
blocks.intent: Appeal for Dinu's attention.
blocks.delivery_hint: Quiet urgency, with emotion held back.

events.change: Aruni directs a verbal appeal toward the absent Dinu.

blocks.intent: Deny immediate contact or reassurance.
blocks.delivery_hint: Let the unanswered attempt linger.

events.change: An attempt to contact Dinu produces no response.

blocks.intent: Leave the surrounding world audible against her isolation.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the remote traffic sound embedded in the weather.

events.change: A remote vehicle signal joins the rain ambience.

blocks.intent: End the discovery before any explanation arrives.
blocks.delivery_hint: A clean visual stop.

blocks.intent: Present the episode's title after the unanswered appeal.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the title separate from the preceding image.

scenes.title: The redirected van
scenes.summary: Dinu hears Aruni's concern about Nimal while driving. Mudalali then orders a different destination, and Dinu changes course after looking at his wrist thread.
scenes.purpose: Bring personal concern and an employer's demand into the same journey without establishing a causal link between them.

people.wants: Continue his journey while taking in the message and new instructions.
Alert Dinu to Nimal's absence and obtain reassurance.

blocks.intent: Establish Dinu at work within the wet city.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the driving contained rather than presenting it as a chase.

events.change: Dinu is established driving through illuminated wet streets.

blocks.intent: Establish an existing personal bond through a keepsake.
blocks.delivery_hint: Let the photograph register without treating the pictured people as present.

events.change: A dashboard photograph associates Dinu and Aruni with a shared village memory.

blocks.intent: Bring Aruni into the journey through recorded audio.
blocks.delivery_hint: Distinguish playback from a live exchange.

events.change: Aruni becomes audible through message playback.

blocks.speaker: C02
blocks.intent: Report Nimal's continued absence and seek support.
blocks.delivery_hint: Controlled concern that becomes more openly fearful.

events.change: Dinu learns that Nimal has not returned and that Aruni is afraid.

blocks.intent: Interrupt the personal concern with a work demand.
blocks.delivery_hint: Keep the arrival of the call matter-of-fact.

events.change: Mudalali initiates contact with Dinu.

blocks.speaker: C04
blocks.intent: Order a route change to a different destination.
blocks.delivery_hint: Brief and authoritative.

events.change: Dinu receives instructions replacing his existing route.

blocks.intent: Connect a private moment of attention with the subsequent change of course without explaining the thread.
blocks.delivery_hint: Give the wrist glance a readable beat before the turn.

events.change: Dinu glances at the thread and steers toward the industrial district.

scenes.title: The garage handoff
scenes.summary: Earlier, Nimal presents material concerning Mudalali's money. Dinu objects to taking it, but Nimal presses him through his relationship with Aruni and places the key in his hand.
scenes.purpose: Establish the key's earlier custody and Dinu's moral resistance without resolving whether he accepts Nimal's proposal.

people.wants: Persuade Dinu to participate in taking the money.
Resist becoming morally equivalent to the men Nimal condemns.

blocks.intent: Move the chronology backward relative to the van journey.
blocks.delivery_hint: Make the temporal shift clear without adding a new event.

blocks.intent: Present tangible support for Nimal's proposal.
blocks.delivery_hint: Make the contents readable without inventing their details.

events.change: Opening the container exposes the key alongside photographic and financial material.

blocks.speaker: C03
blocks.intent: Identify the money and justify targeting it through its alleged origin.
blocks.delivery_hint: Direct and certain.

events.change: Nimal attributes the money to Mudalali's extraction from village development work.

blocks.speaker: C01
blocks.intent: Reject the moral distinction Nimal uses to support taking the money.
blocks.delivery_hint: Quiet but firm.

events.change: Dinu explicitly challenges the proposed taking.

blocks.speaker: C03
blocks.intent: Shift the argument from money to Dinu's fear and attachment to Aruni.
blocks.delivery_hint: Personal and pressing rather than reassuring.

events.change: Nimal uses the possibility of losing Aruni to challenge Dinu's hesitation.

blocks.intent: Make the entrustment physical without treating it as agreement.
blocks.delivery_hint: Show a deliberate handoff at normal speed.

events.change: The key passes from Nimal into Dinu's hand.

blocks.intent: Leave Dinu's decision unresolved.
blocks.delivery_hint: Hold his attention on the object beneath the roof's rain ambience.

events.change: Dinu studies the key without a stated commitment.
Rain remains audible against the roof during the pause.
